<function name="TaskFinished" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>Returns true if the current running <page>Task</page> is finished. 
Tasks finish whenever <page>NPC:TaskComplete</page> is called, which sets `TASKSTATUS_COMPLETE` for all NPCs, also sets `self.bTaskComplete` for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is the current running Task is finished or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
